title: outram-mc GPU: delta-tracking kernel for doubly-heterogeneous media + wire run_keff_delta Gpu

description: Follow-ups deferred from op-p6p.12 (SP3 port). title: genfoam SP3: albedo/Marshak boundary + published multigroup SP3 benchmark
